question: 今年完成清分的资金，按中央、省、市、县四级归属的金额占比是怎样的？
sql: SELECT paybook_full_high.frecrgncode AS frecrgncode, sum(paybook_full_high.fimamt) AS "清分金额" FROM yunnan0508.fne_paybook_full_high AS paybook_full_high WHERE paybook_full_high.fisclear = '1' AND toDate(paybook_full_high.ffilldate) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND toDate(paybook_full_high.ffilldate) < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY paybook_full_high.frecrgncode SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
